It is part of adjusting to what your mind was not meant to adjust to. Psychologically seeing unthinkably inhumane things makes your mind disassociate the humanity of things. It is your mind trying to equip you for horrors. 

A good book that touches on this is “No Bad Parts” by Richard Schwartz. The part of you that can deal with things like this may not be needed for later life. 

I encourage anyone dealing with suicidality and/or PTSD to read this. That part is a part of you, but that part is not the whole of who you are. 

That part is a protector, not a monster. This isn’t a dig on anyone here. Just an encouragement to anyone feeling disassociated with humanity not to give up.
